title: Lunch and Dinner
label: ch:hi-dopahar-raat-ka-khana
canDo: I can name all three meals of the day, and say which one is a borrowed word and which two are phrases Hindi builds from a time plus khana.

payoff.summary: Say all three meals in order, morning to night, and name the odd one out: nashta is borrowed whole, while dopahar ka khana and rat ka khana are built from a time the learner already has plus khana.
payoff.note: Closes HI-A1-LEX-18 in the Hindi A1 inventory, whose note recorded breakfast as taught and lunch and dinner as unnamed. Neither new name introduces a new word: both are transparent compounds of vocabulary the track already owns, which is why one lesson closes two thirds of the point's demand.
